name: nucleo-h745zi-q
comment: A Nucleo-144 board carrying a STM32H745, built against the STM32H7 sources and linked for this part's memory. Programmed through the ST-LINK already on the board.

flash.command: openocd -f interface/stlink.cfg -f target/stm32h7x.cfg -c "program {binary} verify reset exit"
flash.comment: Flashing reaches the part through the ST-LINK, which every Nucleo-144 board carries

CONSOLE_TX.comment: Connected to the ST-LINK virtual COM port

supply.comment: The Nucleo-144 boards take their core supply through the LDO. The CMSIS startup leaves Run* mode according to this, and a part left in Run* mode faults on its first access to flash.
